Hi Sofia — great to meet you over the call. Appreciate the fast follow-up.

Below is the vendor onboarding checklist our AP team requires to create a vendor record and issue a PO:

- Completed, signed W-9 (or W-8BEN-E if non-US)
- Legal company name and DBA (if applicable)
- Tax ID / EIN
- Remit address for the PO (street + city/state/zip)
- ACH bank details (bank name, routing, acct number) or wire instructions
- Primary AP contact name + email and phone
- VAT certificate if you're registering in EU (not applicable for US entities)
- Invoice terms confirmation (Net 30 / Net 45 / etc)

I attached our standard Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf for reference and to make sure nothing is missed. Once we have the completed W-9 and bank details, I'll loop in Michael (Finance) to create a provisional PO number — that usually takes 1-2 business days.

Can you confirm Acme's legal name exactly as it should appear on the PO and whether Net 30 is acceptable?

Thanks — I'll track this and follow up with the PO + DocuSign for vendor agreement once we get the docs.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
